reasons.correctness: Entity field, DtoOut field, both service paths and changeset work; hidden tests 4/4. PLN=0 ties with default 0 for any unlisted currency, so PLN-first is not guaranteed. No ORDER BY on display_order.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset follows the naming, header, rollback and changelog-comment rules. Tests were added to the existing CurrencyServiceUnitTest instead of a new *UnitTest class, as the convention requires.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal additive change inside the currency package. It extends the existing hand-written builder mappings in CurrencyController rather than centralising them. No new mechanisms.
reasons.test_quality: Assertions only check the Currency constructor, getter defaults and the DtoOut setter. Neither toDto nor getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos is exercised for displayOrder, and the seeded order is not checked.
reasons.graph_use: A single graph query located the currency files. The changeset location, the example migration and the changelog were found with ls, grep and find, so navigation relied mostly on search.
